authority: W2 index-amendment policy; the t122_definer_gate_amendment.json record is the shape precedent. This is an ADD (a new coverage leg), not a region amendment: no existing leg is touched, so no replaced_regions / entry_sha_before exists anywhere in this file.
position_semantics: index-field 318 is ZERO-BASED tests[N] notation (proven by the t122/t123/t124 amendments whose entry_sha_before matched the LIVE index): 318 is the position AFTER the current tail tests[317], i.e. APPEND as the 319th entry of the tests array.

base.note: the index sha is recorded as INFORMATION, not as an assertion: the t122 verifier taught (WAL 1318, ac6 frozen-premise class) that pinning the index digest inside a card fence turns a legitimate index move into a false RED. The card's ac6 fence therefore asserts the ENTRY COUNT (318) and the identity of the live tail entry (t88), and recomputes the ADD entry digest from the entry itself - none of which moves when an unrelated amendment is applied.

why_this_leg_exists: The t125 leak that created t126 was invisible to the whole 318-leg sweep: no leg executes backend/scripts/docs_verification.py AS A GENERATOR. Legs 256/257 only test -f its existence, legs 258/259 only grep its constants, and leg 226 checks report-vs-README coherence, not carried digests. A stale CARRIED_DIGESTS entry therefore stayed green until the t122 merge window tried to regenerate the report (WAL 1317). This ADD closes the leak CLASS: it executes the committed generator end to end on every merge sweep, so any future carried digest that stops measuring its committed report turns the sweep RED at the commit that introduced the drift, not two milestones later.

add.entry_keys_note: the entry keys are EXACTLY issue_id, ac, command (the same key set as every other leg; the file's own key order is issue_id/command/ac, so the orchestrator MUST serialise the new entry in the order recorded in entry_keys_order when recomputing entry_sha - the digest is key-order dependent

entry.command: bash -c 'command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "t126 leg RED: uv missing - the committed generator can only be executed under the pinned tool (uv run)"; exit 1; }; command -v cmd.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "t126 leg RED: cmd.exe missing - git must be reached through cmd.exe on this host"; exit 1; }; test -f backend/scripts/docs_verification.py || { echo "t126 leg RED: backend/scripts/docs_verification.py missing - the generator this leg exists to execute"; exit 1; }; test -f docs/criteria/docs_verification.md || { echo "t126 leg RED: docs/criteria/docs_verification.md missing"; exit 1; }; G=$(wslpath -w "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || pwd -W 2>/dev/null || echo "$PWD"); D=$(mktemp -d) || { echo "t126 leg RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }; LOG=$(mktemp) || { echo "t126 leg RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }; ( cd backend && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$D/venv" PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/docs_verification.py ) >"$LOG" 2>&1; RC=$?; tail -12 "$LOG"; if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then echo "t126 leg RED: the committed generator exited rc=$RC on this tree - the log tail above names the failing check, and a stale carried digest is exactly the leak class this leg exists to catch (at the t126 base it was CARRIED_REPORT FAIL digest=517faffb against the stale 38dcbd3d pin)"; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 1; fi; tail -n 1 docs/criteria/docs_verification.md | tr -d "\r" | grep -q "^ALL_CHECKS_PASS$" || { echo "t126 leg RED: the generator exited 0 but the docs report does not end ALL_CHECKS_PASS"; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 1; }; grep -qE "^INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=[0-9]+ entries=[0-9]+$" docs/criteria/docs_verification.md || { echo "t126 leg RED: the regenerated docs report carries no INDEX_ANCHORS PASS line"; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 1; }; grep -qE "^STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1$" docs/criteria/docs_verification.md || { echo "t126 leg RED: the regenerated docs report does not carry STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1 - the nine stored gates are not all green on this tree"; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 1; }; cmd.exe /d /c "git -C $G checkout -- docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "t126 leg RED: the agent_pack restore failed - the generator re-executes the t35 gate which rewrites that evidence doc and it must be restored"; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 1; }; rm -rf "$D"; rm -f "$LOG"; echo "t126 leg GREEN: the committed docs_verification generator executes end to end on this tree - rc=0, the report ends ALL_CHECKS_PASS with INDEX_ANCHORS PASS and STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0, and the agent_pack side effect is restored (the docs report itself is the generator product and is deliberately NOT restored)"'

add.entry_sha_recipe: sha256(json.dumps(entry, separators=(',',':'))) over the NEW entry itself, keys in the order issue_id, ac, command; there is no entry_sha_before because an ADD replaces nothing

command_design.self_contained: one bash -c string; no scratch file is committed; the venv is created in a fresh mktemp -d OUTSIDE the tree via UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT so no backend/.venv byte is touched (WAL 1301 WSL-uv-sync layout hazard)
command_design.crlf_safe: no CR byte appears in the command; every read that digests or greps a working-tree file goes through tr -d "\r"
command_design.no_base64: the command carries no base64 payload - a reader must be able to see exactly what it executes
command_design.restore_discipline: the leg restores ONLY docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md (rewritten as a side effect of re-executing the t35 stored gate). docs/criteria/docs_verification.md is deliberately NOT restored: it is the product of the generator, and restoring it would hide the very half-move (report moved, commit did not) this leg prices.
command_design.residue: the leg leaves the regenerated report in the working tree; the sweep harness runs legs against a fresh checkout, and the orchestrator's post-sweep git status check is where a dirty report is expected and read as the leg's evidence

not_amended.existing_legs: ZERO existing legs are amended by this file. Legs 226/256 are the zero-new-RED pair the card keeps GREEN (ac4); 257 is environment-conditional and 258/259 are disclosed pre-existing RED (healed vs newly broken by this card respectively) - none of them is edited here.

The generator's own INDEX_FLOOR is a >= 217 floor and INDEX_ANCHORS positions 16/54/131/132/133/135/215/216 all sit below the append position, so the ADD cannot move an anchored entry.
